correctness.rationale: Independently re-verified every proved statement by execution, not trust. Graph has 27 vertices and 162 edges; stored 7-coloring has zero conflicts; exhaustive C(27,5) enumeration finds no 5-clique and no 5-independent set, so with the exhibited 4-witnesses omega=alpha=4 and hence chi>=ceil(27/4)=7, giving chi=7. Krawtchouk spectrum [12,0,-3,3] recomputed exactly, so Elphick-Wocjan gives chi_q>=5. The 6-outcome construction was rechecked analytically and numerically (max overlap ~3e-16, orthonormality ~3e-16): per-vertex orthonormality follows from Fourier sums and edge orthogonality from diag(U_a^*U_b)=-1/2 exactly, so chi_q<=6. Covariant no-go proof is sound modulo reading sum over the 12-point shell: shell sums K in {12,0,-3,3} recomputed, forcing 20 ordered differences to -3, i.e. a 5-clique contradicting omega=4. Numerical Stiefel signal is honestly segregated as conjecture.

originality.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING route verified: the (3,3,2) endpoint is the smallest member of the admitted H(n,q,d) threshold family and arose from direct target machinery, not a replacement topic. Full-text inspection of the three nearest lines (Cao et al. 2510.14209 q-ary Hamming; Luo-Ning-Zhang 2512.01195 binary distance-2 plus O_{3l,3} subgraphs; Cao-Feng-Tan 2412.09904 binary/Hadamard) shows none states chi(H(3,3,2))=7, omega=alpha=4, the {5,6} quantum package with explicit 6-coloring certificate, or the covariant rank-1 dim-5 no-go. The closest source gives only the same [5,6] quantum interval at threshold and no classical or no-go statements, so the proved package is new and not mechanically implied.

value.rationale: As an EMERGENT_FINDING with no value presumption, the package still passes the ordinary standard: H(3,3,2) is the natural smallest object of the pre-motivated threshold family, not an arbitrary slice. First exact classical number 7 with certified strict quantum advantage (chi_q<=6<7=chi), exact extremal structure omega=alpha=4, narrowed quantum interval with checkable certificates, and a reusable character-sum covariant no-go theorem plus proof that level-1 NPA/Delsarte sits on the boundary are each retrievable facts a future researcher on Hamming coloring games could need. This is an exact invariant of a natural object with motivation, certificates, and interpretation, not a textbook restatement or unexplained enumeration.
